verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents routing, fallbacks, budgets, BYOK, caching, and request logs. None of it shows the gateway versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations or configurations. Gateway configuration versioning is a fair question for this kind of product, so this is an absence of evidence rather than a wrong axis. Request logs and observability are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
